# Icom LAN wire primitives

`src/icom-lan/protocol.js` adapts protocol field layouts, packet construction
and the credential substitution table from AetherSDR, GPLv3, with wfview
used as a second implementation reference. See
[`docs/icom-lan-sources.md`](../../docs/icom-lan-sources.md) for exact
commits, files, authors and test-vector provenance. The GPLv3 license text
is provided alongside this notice. Preserve these credits and notices.

PiRO remains AGPL-3.0-only. Reference programs are not runtime dependencies.
